sourceMetadata.pageDescription: SARVAM AI Interview Experience and Prep - Backend Engineer (On-Device AI) Internship: Disclaimer: This post is written purely to share my experience and the way I prepared. It is not a leaked question bank — I'm intentionally not reproducing exact interview questions, and I'm not naming any individual interviewer or recruiter out of respect for their privacy. If you're prepping for something similar, treat this as a map of what kind of thinking to build, not a script to memorize. A few months ago I interviewed for a Backend Engineer Intern role at Sarvam AI, focused on on-device AI — running inference for LLMs locally on a user's laptop or phone instead of hitting a cloud API. I'd applied directly through their careers portal — no referral, no recruiter reaching out first. I went through the full loop: an async take-home, a technical panel, and a final round. I was informed over WhatsApp that I'd cleared all the rounds, with an immediate-joining timeline attached, which didn't line up with my schedule, so I couldn't take it up. But the process itself was genuinely one of the more interesting technical interview experiences I've had, so I wanted to write it up. One thing worth flagging upfront: Sarvam's process was quite different from most companies I've interviewed with. There wasn't a single DSA/LeetCode-style round anywhere in the loop — it was almost entirely real-world systems and problem-solving, grounded in an actual product you'd be shipping.
